notes: This contract records Umbra's second bounded public timestamped service family in the non-installable IEEE 1516.1-2025 development profile: non-regional timestamped Update Attribute Values with federation-owned queueing for time-constrained recipients, recipient-specific passels, callback-gated Reflect Attribute Values delivery before Time Advance Grant, official timestamp/order/retraction callback fields, sender lower-bound validation, and Retract before delivery. It deliberately does not claim timestamped Delete Object Instance, directed or regional forms, NMR/FQR/flush services, asynchronous delivery, request-retraction callbacks, remote transport, package support, catalog evidence, JUnit evidence, protected review, or conformance.
